inflight: The AC1021 ACAD_TABLE record is solved, and the method was the same one that cracked the VPORT: let AutoCAD mint the reference, then measure. Two AutoCAD-converted tables — a 2x2 of single letters and a 3x2 of 1-to-8 character cells — showed the cell is 109 bits for a one-character text, that its record carries TWO string-stream entries per cell, and that a field varying 97, 98, 99, 100 across the four cells was the text itself, inline in the data stream. That is a table VALUE, not a string: the additional-data flag comes first, then the format flags, the data type, the byte-counted UTF-16 text, the unit type, and finally the value's format string and its rendered form. Writing a bare string there is what AutoCAD had been refusing. Both references now decode, our own output opens at AUDIT 0, and AutoCAD reads its cells back as 2 rows x 2 columns with the text intact.
recentlyLanded: R2007 ACAD_TABLE written and gated — the cell content is a table VALUE, pinned against two AutoCAD-minted references
